title: kelleria lyallii
intro: Kelleria lyallii, commonly known as the New Zealand snow buttercup, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Maori medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Kelleria lyallii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exert sedative and anti-anxiety effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
